name: gamesuite-relay-server
description: Minimal WebSocket room relay for GameSuite's OnlineTransport (roadmap item 12), plus the wave-5 additions: room metadata, quick-chat and a matchmaking queue. Not a game server — it never inspects or validates game payloads, only rooms and forwards bytes between the players in them, exactly like MultiplayerTransport's own send()/onMessageReceived contract on the Android side. All game rules stay host-authoritative on-device, same as the existing Nearby transport.

scripts.test: node smoke-test.js && node identity-test.js && node seat-ranges-test.js && node room-meta-test.js && node ratelimit-test.js && node quickchat-test.js && node queue-test.js
